citeAs: Krizhevsky, A., Nair, V., and Hinton, G. (2009). CIFAR-10 (Canadian Institute for Advanced Research). http://www.cs.toronto.edu/~kriz/cifar.html
creator: Alex Krizhevsky, Vinod Nair, Geoffrey Hinton (Canadian Institute for Advanced Research)
description: CIFAR-10 is a dataset containing 60,000 32x32 color images, each labeled as one of ten classes. It is divided into a training set of 50,000 images and a validation set of 10,000 images. It is one of the most widely used datasets in machine learning, facilitating thousands of research projects per year.
name: CIFAR-10
rai:dataCollection: CIFAR-10 consists of 60,000 32x32 color images across 10 classes, collected and curated by Krizhevsky, Nair, and Hinton at the Canadian Institute for Advanced Research.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: 60,000 32x32 color images labeled across 10 classes, split into 50,000 training images and 10,000 test/validation images.
rai:dataUseCases: CIFAR-10 is used for benchmarking image classification models, facilitating thousands of machine learning research projects per year. It is used for training speed competitions (e.g., DAWNBench), data attribution studies, training variance studies, and hyperparameter comparison experiments.
